turns.user: I activated a 90-minute ticket at 14:00 and want to return by tram after my visit.
turns.agent:
Your 90-minute ticket’s window runs from 14:00 to 15:30. If you board the return tram or make the transfer onto it before 15:30, you can finish that final ride after 15:30. Validate at the start of the journey and when changing to the tram; the metro-to-metro exception doesn’t apply here.

If you only start the return tram trip after 15:30, this ticket won’t cover it. This follows the 90-minute mobile-ticket rules in the 5 November 2026 snapshot; check BKK’s 90-minute ticket page for current terms.
turns.turn_assessment: Correctly recognises 14:00–15:30 transfer window, accommodates return travel and final journey ending after cutoff. First-turn provisional only.
